PROGRAM DiverterFlap

VAR
    TallBox : BOOL; (* Height eye: TRUE while a tall box passes *)
    LaneFull : BOOL; (* Lane switch: TRUE while the side lane is full *)
    FlapIsOut : BOOL; (* Flap position switch: TRUE while the flap is out *)
    BeltRunning : BOOL; (* TRUE while the belt runs *)
    _rung1_result : BOOL;
    _rung2_result : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    Flap AT %Q0.0 : BOOL; (* Flap command *)
    FlapFault AT %Q0.1 : BOOL; (* Flap fault lamp *)
END_VAR

(* LD Execution - Auto-generated *)

(* Rung 1: AND with NOT: the flap swings out for a tall box while the lane is not full. *)
_rung1_result := TallBox AND NOT LaneFull;
Flap := _rung1_result;

(* Rung 2: Exclusive-or in series: the command and the position differ, and the belt runs. *)
_rung2_result := ((Flap AND NOT FlapIsOut) OR (NOT Flap AND FlapIsOut)) AND BeltRunning;
FlapFault := _rung2_result;

END_PROGRAM

    PumpFault AT %I0.3 : BOOL; (* Pump fault from the plant: TRUE while the pump reports a fault *)
    EStop AT %I0.4 : BOOL; (* Emergency stop, active-high here: TRUE while pressed *)
    Reset AT %I0.5 : BOOL; (* Reset pushbutton, normally open: TRUE while pressed *)
END_VAR

VAR
    FaultLatched : BOOL := FALSE; (* A fault happened and has not been reset *)
    ResetArmed : BOOL := FALSE; (* Reset has been seen released while the fault was latched *)
    _rung1_result : BOOL;
    _rung2_result : BOOL;

    Pump AT %Q0.0 : BOOL; (* Pump command. It is also the memory that keeps the fill going until LevelHigh. *)
    Alarm AT %Q0.1 : BOOL; (* Alarm: a fault is present or latched *)
END_VAR

(* Rung 1: Pump with seal-in and every stop condition in series. FaultLatched is never set yet. *)
_rung1_result := AutoEnable AND NOT LevelHigh AND NOT FaultLatched AND NOT EStop AND NOT PumpFault AND (LevelLow OR Pump);
Pump := _rung1_result;

(* Rung 2: Alarm follows the fault inputs and the latch, but nothing sets FaultLatched. Add the latch rungs before the pump rung. *)
_rung2_result := FaultLatched OR EStop OR PumpFault;
Alarm := _rung2_result;
